description.en: Hotel / Aparthotel in Melbourne, Australia. The asset occupies 17,010 m². It operates with 150 keys. The asset is ready to occupy. Title is held freehold under Australia law. The listing has been verified by the XARU HOME desk and its documentation reviewed. This record is platform demonstration inventory: the structure, the workflow and the data model are the production ones, the asset is not.
